plugins.Author: WigglyMuffin, CryoTechnic
plugins.Description:
Automates quests from accept to turn-in - main scenario, class and job, allied society and side quests.

Smart navigation plans the route across zones using aetherytes, aethernet and transports, then walks you to each objective. Dialogue, interactions and turn-ins are handled for you.
plugins.Name: Questionable

plugins.Author: WigglyMuffin
plugins.Description:
Uploads your game statistics (such as quest progress, gil, retainer stats) to an InfluxDB or QuestDB instance, making it possible to automatically track your progress through external tools such as Grafana.

Originally created by Liza Carvelli.
plugins.Name: Influx
plugins.Punchline: Sync game stats to InfluxDB or QuestDB

plugins.Author: MacaronDream, DhogGPT, XA
plugins.Description:
Automated character rotation and quest sequence execution for Questionable.

Automates multi-character MSQ progression by intelligently switching between characters based on quest completion and level requirements. Features include:
- Automatic character switching and quest tracking
- MSQ progression monitoring across all characters
- Allied Society quest rotation and prioritization
- Event quest automation with prerequisite checking
- Chauffeur Mode for following main character through quests
- Data Center travel automation
- Stop point configuration for controlled progression

Required Plugins: Questionable, AutoRetainer
plugins.Name: Questionable Companion
plugins.Punchline: Automated character rotation and quest sequence execution

plugins.Author: WigglyMuffin, CryoTechnic
plugins.Description:
Questionable now ships as "WigglyQuest". Its internal name changed so it no longer shares Dalamud's install and config folders with the PunishXIV fork of Questionable; the plugin you see in the installer is still called Questionable.

This final build under the old name does no questing. It opens a short guide, installs WigglyQuest from the same repository with one click, and then points you at the plugin installer to remove itself. WigglyQuest copies your settings and local quest files on its first start.
plugins.Name: Questionable (moved to WigglyQuest)
plugins.Punchline: Questionable has moved to WigglyQuest - this build installs it for you.
